result.description: A fictional pen display tablet designed for digital illustration, note-taking, and classroom annotation. The OrbitPad 14 features a 13.8-inch laminated IPS panel, 4,096 levels of pressure sensitivity, programmable shortcut keys, and USB-C display connectivity for Windows, macOS, and select Linux systems. It includes a rechargeable stylus, anti-glare coating, and a lightweight aluminum stand for angled drafting sessions.
